name: ollama-collaborators
description: A VSCode extension for two Ollama models to collaborate.

ollamaCollaborators.agentOne.baseURL.description: Base URL for the first Ollama agent (e.g., http://localhost:11434).

ollamaCollaborators.agentOne.model.description: Model name for the first Ollama agent (e.g., llama2, codellama).

ollamaCollaborators.agentTwo.baseURL.description: Base URL for the second Ollama agent (e.g., http://anotherhost:11434).

ollamaCollaborators.agentTwo.model.description: Model name for the second Ollama agent (e.g., mistral, llama2).

ollamaCollaborators.files.autoOpenCreate.description: Automatically open files after they are created by an agent action.

ollamaCollaborators.enableAutonomousMode.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Enable autonomous mode where agents can execute a sequence of actions. Requires careful review of agent plans.

ollamaCollaborators.autonomous.enableShe.markdownDescription: EXPERIMENTAL: Allow agents in autonomous mode to request shell command execution. **Security Risk:** Only enable if you understand the implications and trust the source of the agent/plan. Requires `ollamaCollaborators.enableAutonomousMode` to also be true.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
